decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 61 Park Road, Chiswick, London W4 3EY. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling.

Condition : 5 - The application for the erection of single storey garden house with basement to the rear of main house and installation of decking, as shown on drawings numbered WE/CH/210PA, WE/CH/110PA2, WE/CH/111PA2, WE/CH/10, received on 27th October 2006, is recommended for approval as the size, position and style of the garden house and basement would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of single storey garden house with basement to the rear of main house and installation of decking
